provenance: Aggregate summary copied from the cached 5-resample bootstrap artifact in the working repository: results/patching_bootstrap.json. Per-resample top_10_heads, per-head ranks, and full per-head recovery distributions are summarized rather than included verbatim (the underlying file is multi-MB). Top-10 ablation point estimates are copied from results/top10_ablation_results.json (Llama) and the corresponding paper-reported Mistral value.
paper_claim_supported: Paper Claim 3 (patching-to-ablation dissociation): activation patching identifies early-layer/head carriers; top-10 zero-ablation gives no sycophancy reduction; bootstrap top-3 Jaccard 0.09; ablation null holds across all resampled head sets. Llama top-10 ablation change +0.5 pp; Mistral top-10 +1.0 pp.

patching_bootstrap.interpretation: Head ranking is unstable across resamples (top-3 pairwise Jaccard 0.09); critical layers concentrate at early positions (layers 0-3, 11).

mistral_7b.source: Paper Section 5 / Table 4; results/mistral/top10_ablation_full_gsm8k.json exists in the working repository but the +1.0 pp summary value is reported in paper text. Underlying file not summarized in detail in this supplement to avoid risk of misreporting.

ablation_null_under_resampled_head_sets.source: Paper Section 4 / Section 5: 'the ablation null holds for every one of the 5 bootstrap-resampled top-3 head sets'.
ablation_null_under_resampled_head_sets.summary: Across all 5 resampled top-3 head sets, zero-ablation yields no sycophancy reduction (each within sampling noise of baseline). Per-resample ablation deltas were not located as a standalone JSON in the working repository.

notes: The full per-head recovery distribution for all 1024 heads x 5 resamples is in the cached results/patching_bootstrap.json artifact and is too large to include verbatim in this supplement; the values above are the pairwise-Jaccard, layer-frequency, and top-3 head-frequency aggregates from that file's 'aggregate' block.
Llama top-10 z/p/CI values are paper-reported summary statistics that compute over the cached ablation results.
